name: IC Logic — 5V, 3.6V — BGA
description: Surface-mount logic IC cluster for 5V and 3.6V applications featuring level translators in 12-bump BGA packaging.
selection_hints: Select when requiring SMD logic level translators rated for 5V or 3.6V operation.
Choose TXB0104YZT for 1.36x1.86mm DSBGA-12 footprint with 3x4 layout.
Choose TXB0104ZXU for 2.0x2.5mm MicroStar Junior BGA-12 footprint with 4x3 layout.
avoid_when: The design requires package styles other than BGA.
Target PCB layout requires a pitch other than 0.5mm.
Logic voltage requirements differ from 5V or 3.6V.
